          Citation options

          Reference section and original text

          Original text stays intact. Skipping pauses playback and keeps your place. Mixed explanatory parentheses stay visible.

          Anchoring keeps your eye on one spot: each word's highlighted letter, about a third of the way in, lands between the two marks, so longer words sit to the right. The soft change lasts at most 40 ms so it never cuts into the time you need to recognise the word.

          Appearance applies to all readings on this device.

          Welcome to Still

          Read more, with less effort

          • Your eyes stay still. Words come to you one at a time, so there’s no hunting along the line and nothing else competing for your attention.
          • Tap to pause. Hold to see the sentence. Missed something? Tap the left side to go back 15 words, or go back a sentence with the arrow beside Play.
          • A few minutes a day. Pick a small daily goal and build a streak. Short and often beats long and rare.
          One email when it’s out, nothing else. Your bookshelf stays on your device.

          How much reading a day feels doable? Small is fine: you can change it any time.

          Permanent deletion

          About Still

          Still displays words at an adjustable average pace, with normal text reading and tools for reviewing your documents.

          Development build · 0.1.0. Publisher and support details must be finalized before release.

          This website counts visits without cookies: one anonymous tally per visit, noting only whether it’s your first. Third-party licenses: PDF.js · WordNet dictionary · wordfreq word frequencies

          Privacy information (draft) · Third-party notices · Help and limitations

          Your imported documents and notes stay in this app unless you choose to export or share them. On the web, read aloud's natural voices send the sentences being read to OpenAI to make the sound. Backups are readable JSON files, not password-protected archives. Anyone with a copy can read them.

          Send feedback

          Goes straight to the person who makes Still. Your readings are never included.
